item.title: Abraham Lincoln 1860 Cooper Union portrait by Mathew Brady
item.description: Mathew Brady's 1860 Cooper Union portrait of Abraham Lincoln, often cited as a key factor in his presidential election. 19th-century portrait photography, public domain, free at Mosaic.

item.title: Samuel F. B. Morse portrait by Mathew Brady, 1855, 19th-century photography
item.description: Mathew Brady's portrait of Samuel F. B. Morse, the teacher under whom Brady trained before becoming a leading portrait photographer. Vintage 19th-century portrait photography, public domain, free at Mosaic.

item.title: Mathew Brady portraits 1844–1870: Lincoln, Grant, Custer and Civil War photography
item.description: Portraits by Mathew Brady, the leading American portraitist of the mid-19th century: Abraham Lincoln, Ulysses S. Grant, George Armstrong Custer, Franklin Pierce, and Civil War views. Trained under Samuel Morse, studio in New York from 1844. Public domain, free to download at Mosaic.
